text: Váš návrh je vynikající. Právě proto ho musíme důkladně odložit.
pokyny: Voice acting for a comedy point-and-click adventure game. Speak Czech with native pronunciation, natural pacing and comic timing. Do not read stage directions. Character: Chairman Evermore, elderly bureaucrat, kind, slow and unhurried, never says no, only 'next phase'. Delivery: kindly.
